job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced GenAI Solution Advisor with strong expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Anthropic Claude technologies. The ideal candidate will provide technical and solution advisory support for identifying, designing, and implementing enterprise GenAI solutions using Claude, Claude API, and Claude Code. The role involves working closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, evaluate AI use cases, develop solution architectures, and guide engineering teams in implementing scalable AI-powered solutions. The candidate should have hands-on experience with LLM applications, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, and agentic AI, API integrations, and cloud-based AI solutions, along with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical business solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Provide technical advisory and solution architecture guidance for Generative AI initiatives.
Identify and evaluate business use cases suitable for GenAI and LLM adoption.
Design solutions leveraging Anthropic Claude, Claude API, and Claude Code.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and data teams to define AI solution requirements.
Develop and validate GenAI proof-of-concepts and technical solutions.
Provide guidance on prompt engineering, LLM integration, RAG, AI agents, and agentic AI solutions.
Define technical architecture, integration patterns, APIs, and implementation approaches.
Support development teams throughout the implementation and integration of GenAI solutions.
Evaluate AI technologies and recommend appropriate approaches based on business and technical requirements.
Document solution designs, technical recommendations, and implementation guidelines.
Ensure GenAI solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
